records.name: Fake Death
records.skill_description: Feign being knocked out by falling into Yamcha's death pose, then rise with a surprise kick that can counterattack nearby opponents.
records.mechanics_notes: Activation causes the user to fall back and remain in the fake-KO pose while the input is held. The startup and get-up attack have documented invulnerability frames, and the get-up kick can stun on contact. Exact frame durations and version-sensitive punish windows are not promoted to canonical numeric data.
records.acquisition_notes: Yamcha's Initiation Test is the canonical Xenoverse 2 mentor route. The skill is also available to Yamcha's customizable partner.
records.pve_notes: Mentor-training acquisition; no Parallel Quest drop or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: The skill's distinctive property is its invulnerability during the fake-death sequence and get-up. Historical player reports discuss balance changes, so exact frame behavior should be treated as version-sensitive.
